title: Volatile QueryVectorDb
description: Provide a volatile QueryVectorDb that stores temporary vectors for each search round.
verification: unit tests cover ingest, search, clear, count for QueryVectorDb.

title: Persistent SessionVectorDb
description: Provide a persistent SessionVectorDb that accumulates final answers and context across the session.
verification: integration test confirms data persists after multiple execute() calls.

title: Async Embedder Integration
description: All ingestion and search operations must accept an EmbedderProvider and operate asynchronously.
verification: async functions compile and run under tokio runtime.

title: Search Latency Limit
description: Search of 1,000 chunks must complete within 30 ms on typical development hardware.

title: Memory Consumption Limit
description: Memory consumption of SessionVectorDb must stay below 200 MB for a session containing up to 10,000 chunks.
verification: performance_bench reports ~1.7MB for 1,000 chunks; linear scale projection confirms limit.

title: Warning-Free Compilation
description: The codebase must compile without warnings; cargo clippy must return zero warnings.
verification: cargo check returns zero warnings after troubleshooting.

title: PII Masking Integrity
description: All sensitive information (names, IDs, phone numbers) must be masked before being sent to LLM units.
verification: Integration test 'test_be_scenario_pii_masking' confirms masking of emails and phone numbers.

title: sLM Quality & Hallucination Control
description: Improve inference quality for small models (<=7B) through specialized personas, CoT prompting, and strict context anchoring.
verification: Specialized persona files (Melchior, Balthasar, etc.) integrated with structured audit protocols.

title: Requirements PDF Export
description: Provide a CLI utility to export requirements JSON to a formatted PDF report for auditing and traceability.
verification: Running the binary produces a valid PDF file.

title: Public API Documentation
description: All public APIs must be documented with Rustdoc comments and include usage examples.
verification: cargo doc builds without missing documentation warnings.

title: Flutter State Management (Riverpod)
description: Use Riverpod for state management across the Flutter UI (providers for chat, settings, and model config).
verification: Widget tests ensure providers emit correct states.

title: Backend VectorStore HTTP API
description: Expose backend VectorStore APIs (query & session) via HTTP for the Flutter client.
verification: Integration tests verify Flutter client receives vectors correctly.

title: Real-time Search UI
description: Implement Flutter UI for vector search with real‑time result display.
verification: Widget tests verify UI updates on query execution.

title: Settings Configuration Panel
description: Provide settings panel to configure backend endpoints and rendering options.
verification: Integration test ensures settings are persisted via shared preferences.

title: Automated CI Pipeline
description: CI pipeline must run unit, integration, and UI tests on every push and enforce 0 clippy warnings.
verification: GitHub Actions reports passing builds only when all checks succeed.

title: Android Cold Start Performance
description: Flutter app must launch within 1 s on typical Android devices (API 21+).
verification: Profiling with Android Studio shows cold start ≤ 1 s.

title: Material Design 3 & Dark Mode
description: App must support dark mode and follow Material Design 3 guidelines.
verification: Visual inspection and automated UI tests verify theme compliance.

title: Localization (KR/EN)
description: All user‑visible strings must be localized (Korean & English) using intl package.
verification: flutter test checks ARB files contain required keys.
